title: Gingerbread Brownies
changes_from_base: Molasses and warm ginger in a cakier cocoa batter baked in a larger tin.
summary: Cakey chocolate bars spiced with ginger and cinnamon and sweetened with treacle.
equipment: 23 x 33 cm baking tin, lined with baking paper

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 160 °C (140 °C fan) and line the large tin. Whisk the flour, cocoa, salt, baking powder, bicarbonate and cinnamon together.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.text: Put the chocolate in a large bowl. Melt the butter in the pan, add the ginger and sizzle for 15 seconds, then pour it over the chocolate. Leave 5 min and stir smooth.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Whisk in the brown sugar, then the eggs and treacle until glossy, and stir in the dry mix until no flour shows.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread in the tin and bake 28-32 min, until a cocktail stick comes out with a few moist crumbs.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely in the tin, then cut into 24 bars.

tips: Frying the ginger in butter wakes up its flavour.
Measure treacle with an oiled spoon.
They taste even spicier the next day.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep in an airtight box at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
